pages.text: Spells live in spellbooks. A caster's first spell is already in their book. New spells come as $(item)scrolls$(): bind them into a book at an $(item)Inscription Table$() (there's one in Firelink's chapel).
pages.title: Spellbooks

pages.text: A spellbook only works $(l)equipped$(): open your Curios slots with $(l)'$() (or the button in your inventory) and put it in the $(l)Spellbook$() slot.$(br2)Then cast with $(l)mouse side button 5$(), and pick spells from the wheel on $(l)side button 4$().

$(l)Don't right-click a scroll$() unless you mean to: reading it casts the spell once and the scroll crumbles. Inscribed, it's yours to keep.$(br2)Necromancy is Goety's business: souls power its wands. Its focus wand is on $(l)Z$(), the focus wheel on $(l)=$().
